meta.name: hyperplan
meta.description: Adversarial multi-agent planning skill for omo-senpi. Self-orchestrates a 5-member hostile team (categories unspecified-low, unspecified-high, deep, ultrabrain, artistry) via the native lead team tools for ruthless cross-critique debate, distills only the insights that survive the attacks, then MANDATORILY hands the distilled bundle to a planner task (load_skills ulw-plan) for executable plan formalization. Use when planning needs maximum rigor and surfacing of weak assumptions, blind spots, and over-engineering. Triggers: 'hyperplan', 'hpp', 'adversarial plan', 'hostile planning', 'cross-critique plan', '하이퍼플랜', '적대적 계획', '교차 비평'.

copy.tagline: 用对抗式辩论打磨规划方案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果您的规划需要暴露隐藏的弱点并提升严谨性
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your planning needs rigorous critique to surface hidden flaws

howto.what: Claude 会自组一支5人敌对团队,成员互相抨击对方的方案,只保留经得起攻击的意见,然后强制交给专门的规划任务(ulw-plan)整理成可执行计划。
howto.when: 当你说出“hyperplan”、“hpp”、“adversarial plan”等关键词或要求进行对抗性、交叉批判式规划时触发。

say.text: 用 hyperplan 规划这个项目。
say.note: 启动5人对抗团队,产出经得住攻击的方案。

say.text: hpp,对抗性审查我的产品方案。
say.note: 团队会攻击方案漏洞,只保留幸存观点。

say.text: 启动作战规划,交叉批判这份计划。
say.note: 触发同样的对抗流程,交给规划任务收尾。

howto.what_en: Claude self-orchestrates a 5-member hostile team that cross-critiques each other's proposals, keeps only the insights surviving the attacks, then mandatorily hands them to a planner task (ulw-plan) for executable formalization.
howto.when_en: Triggers on keywords like 'hyperplan', 'hpp', or 'adversarial plan', or when you ask for adversarial/cross-critique planning.

say_en.note: Starts the 5-member hostile team and produces survivor-backed plans.

say_en.text: Run hpp to adversarially review my product plan.
say_en.note: The team attacks weak spots; only defensible points survive.

say_en.text: Use adversarial planning to cross-critique this plan.
say_en.note: Same hostile flow, then a planner formalizes the result.
